## Primary Services
1. **Custom WordPress Development**:
   - Figma-to-production builds
   - Modular Gutenberg blocks and ACF integration
   - Custom themes without bloated page builders
   - Multilingual sites (Polylang, WPML) and WooCommerce
2. **Shopify Storefront Development**:
   - Custom Liquid themes and reusable sections
   - Structured schema controls for easy merchant editing
   - Product and collection templates with custom variants
   - Specialized quote, request, or artwork upload workflows
3. **Frontend & Performance Engineering**:
   - Core Web Vitals optimization and layout stability
   - Accessibility-focused implementation (WCAG compliant)
   - Technical SEO and analytics integration (GA4, GTM)

## Selected Case Studies
- [WWF Canada](https://wwf.ca): Accessible WordPress architecture for content-heavy conservation campaigns, species indexes, and bilingual donation flows.
- [MVP Visuals](https://mvpvisuals.com): Custom Shopify storefront with artwork upload workflows, request-a-quote flows, and merchant-editable Liquid sections.
- [Bopper Media](https://boppermedia.com): Custom WordPress theme with Gutenberg blocks, dark/light theme switching, and subtle micro-interactions.
- [The Energy Coalition](https://energycoalition.org): Custom WordPress site with ACF, Polylang multilingual publishing, and Mailchimp integration.
- [11-nil](https://11-nil.com): Shopify Liquid store with product variant merchandising and responsive design.
